universal_lens: A hybrid vision-based framework integrates KNN background subtraction and HSV color segmentation to quantify tennis contact point precision via spatial overlap ratios and vertical deviation distributions. Tennis stroke contact point analysis via computer vision enables biomechanical performance quantification through normalized trajectory mapping.
gsi_mapping: Bayesian inference models skill-level and gender effects on contact point accuracy using two-way ANOVA with posterior probability distributions over stroke event parameters. Bayesian inference models player skill levels using contact point distributions, with conformal prediction bounds on stroke consistency and technical accuracy.
gse_mapping: Situational reasoning maps stroke execution states through temporal contact point transitions, enabling state-transition feedback loops for real-time performance adjustment. Situational reasoning engine maps stroke kinematics to real-time tactical adjustments, transitioning between skill tiers based on contact point variance and temporal dynamics.
